scope: 135 Ultimate/Mega/Armor/No Level inventory entries. Roles, game types and every new move label are authored design choices, not official classifications or canonical move claims. No artwork or native combat changes are included.
preservationPolicy: Existing forms1–66, stat curves, skills and evolution edges remain unchanged. Explicit verified existing-form bindings override these candidate skill/role records in full; this file must never rename or rebalance a preserved profile.

combatTierPolicy.No Level: Calumon explicitly uses Rookie-tier Warden; source category remains No Level.

skillsPolicy: All labels select the existing Physical/Heavy/Magic mechanics. They do not add species-specific effects or independently grant canonical move rights.
edgePolicy: Proposed edges are separate, inactive authored routes for parent review. All endpoints are named inventory entries outside the preserved66; aliases and source-game categories do not automatically create a route. Confirm stable identity and explicit unlock rules before activation.
